length

lengthBefore: aSector

	^(sectors copyUpTo: aSector)
		sum: [ :eachSector | eachSector length ]
		ifEmpty: [ 0 * kilometer ]

sectorAt: aPosition

	^sectors detect: [ :aSector | aPosition <= ((self lengthBefore: aSector) + aSector length) ]

includes: aCar

Turbo comment: 'I am the turbo of a car. I know the boost that has to be applied to the maximum speed of the car. My subclasses know whether I am activated or not, and answer the turbo the car has after being activated or deactivated. I am immutable: instead of changing my state I answer the turbo that replaces me.'.
ActivatedTurbo comment: 'I am a turbo that is activated. I increase the maximum speed of the car with my boost, and when I am deactivated I answer a deactivated turbo holding the next boost of the sequence.'.
DeactivatedTurbo comment: 'I am a turbo that is not activated. I do not change the maximum speed of the car. I know the boost to apply when I am activated, which happens only if the car can overtake another one using turbo.'.
TurboBoost comment: 'I am the increase a turbo applies to the maximum speed of a car in one use. I know the boost that follows me, so my subclasses form the sequence of boosts a turbo gives: 20%, 10%, 5% and then nothing.'.
IncreasingTurboBoost comment: 'I increase the maximum speed of a car by a percentage of it.'.
ExhaustedTurboBoost comment: 'I am the boost of a turbo that has been used three times: I do not increase the maximum speed of a car and I am followed by myself, because an exhausted turbo never boosts again.'.
Sector comment: 'I am a part of a track. I know my length and the position of each car running in me. My subclasses know whether the drivers can use the turbo of their cars in me.'.
TurboEnabledSector comment: 'I am a sector where the turbo can be used, provided the car using it overtakes another car that is less than one second ahead of it.'.
TurboDisabledSector comment: 'I am a sector where the turbo can not be used.'.
NoSector comment: 'I am the sector of a car that has not been put in a track yet. I let no car use its turbo.'.
Track comment: 'I am the path where a competition takes place. I am made of sectors, and I know the position of a car as the distance from my beginning, no matter the sector the car is in.'.
Competition comment: 'I am a race. I know the track where I am run, the number of laps and I move the cars racing in me, giving them the illusion that the track is closed: a car that reaches the end of the track goes on from its beginning.'.
F1SimulatorTest comment: 'I test the model of the F1 simulator: cars, their turbos, the sectors and tracks they run on and the competitions they take part in.'.
